metadata.notes: Central bank inflation forecasts and policy rates

US.source_full: Federal Reserve - Summary of Economic Projections
US.note: Fed revised PCE inflation up to 2.7% for 2026 amid Middle East energy disruptions. Expects 1 cut in 2026.
US.key_quote: Inflation remains somewhat elevated; uncertainty increased

EA.note: ECB revised 2026 inflation up sharply (1.9%→2.6%) due to Middle East energy price surge. Rates held at 2.00%.
EA.key_quote: Headline inflation projected to increase to 2.6% in 2026 reflecting energy price rises

UK.source_full: Bank of England - Monetary Policy Report
UK.note: BoE expects CPI to fall to 2.1% by Q2 2026, notably lower than Nov forecast. Energy price declines from Budget 2025 driving near-term relief.
UK.key_quote: CPI inflation expected to fall to 2.1% in Q2 2026, lower than anticipated in November

CA.source_full: Bank of Canada - Monetary Policy Report
CA.note: BoC expects inflation near 2% target. Trade uncertainty elevated due to US tariff review. Growth modest at 1.1% for 2026.
CA.key_quote: Inflation expected to stay close to 2% target; trade risks elevated

AU.source_full: Reserve Bank of Australia - Statement on Monetary Policy
AU.note: RBA hiked rates 25bp to 3.85% after inflation surprised to upside. Trimmed mean to peak 3.7% mid-2026, above 2-3% target band until early 2027.
AU.key_quote: Underlying inflation revised up; expected to peak at 3.7% in mid-2026

NZ.source_full: Reserve Bank of New Zealand - Monetary Policy Statement
NZ.note: RBNZ held OCR at 2.25%. Inflation temporarily above 3% target band but expected to fall to ~2% by early 2027. Significant excess capacity in economy.
NZ.key_quote: Inflation expected to decline to around target midpoint over next 12 months

ZA.source_full: South African Reserve Bank - MPC Statement
ZA.note: SARB held repo rate at 6.75% (4-2 vote). Near-term inflation forecast lower with stronger rand and lower oil. Risks from food (foot-and-mouth) and electricity prices.
ZA.key_quote: Near-term inflation forecast has fallen; gradual rate cuts expected as inflation subsides

JP.source_full: Bank of Japan - Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices
JP.forecast_type: Median Policy Board forecast (core CPI ex-fresh food)
JP.note: BoJ held rate at 0.75% (8-1 vote). CPI expected to dip below 2% temporarily before rising on energy costs. Will continue raising rates if outlook holds.
JP.key_quote: CPI to dip below 2% temporarily; upward pressure from energy prices ahead

IN.source_full: Reserve Bank of India - Monetary Policy Statement
IN.note: RBI held repo rate at 5.25% with neutral stance. FY2025-26 CPI revised to 2.1% (from 2.0%). New CPI base year 2024=100 from Feb 2026.
IN.key_quote: FY26 inflation projection revised to 2.1%; neutral stance maintained

KR.note: BOK held rate at 2.50% unanimously for 6th consecutive meeting. GDP growth revised up to 2.0%. Headline CPI projected at 2.1%.
KR.key_quote: Growth forecast revised up to 2.0%; inflation near target

SG.note: MAS uses exchange rate policy, not interest rates. Core inflation forecast 0.5-1.5% for 2026. Next MAS policy review in April 2026.

VE.note: Post-hyperinflation recovery. BCV does not publish forecasts. Data reliability uncertain. Actual 2025 inflation was ~475%.
VE.key_quote: Inflation moderating from hyperinflation peak but remains elevated

CN.note: PBoC does not publish inflation forecasts. IMF projections used. 1Y LPR held at 3.00% for 10 consecutive months.
CN.key_quote: Deflationary pressures amid weak domestic demand
